response.original_title: ((Faq-Guide)) How to get connecting rooms on Seabourn Cruise Line
response.overview: To book connecting rooms on Seabourn Cruise Line, call Seabourn directly at +1-866-829-1280 or use a certified travel agent. The Seabourn website only allows booking one stateroom at a time, making it nearly impossible to guarantee adjoining doors without speaking to a booking agent who can access the full cabin inventory. Do not attempt to book two separate rooms on the website and hope they are side-by-side. Call Seabourn customer service directly +1-866-829-1280 or use a travel agent so they can view the ship's layout and lock in two specific, connecting cabins at the same time.
